scams.name: Recife (REC) Airport Taxi & Boa Viagem Transfer Overcharge
scams.description: Recife Guararapes Airport (REC, 11 km from Boa Viagem) is North-East Brazil's main coastal arrival point and hosts a 2025 taxi-overcharge ecosystem common to Brazilian airports. r/Brazil 'Airport and regional safety' (comments/129p0pf, 2024) is the canonical community anchor on REC arrival logistics. r/Brazil 'About to go to brazil for 5 months' (comments/1mn8zdq, 2025) is a 2025 community anchor. r/Brazil 'First visit to Brazil and considering Recife' (comments/1qmghss, 2026) is a 2026 first-person anchor. r/Brazil 'Travelling to Recife for 2 weeks. What are the must see and' (comments/1s447c, 2024) and 'Recife for a few hours' (comments/1pftvyz, 2025) are community baseline. r/Brazil 'planning solo trip to Recife, Natal & Salvador. Is it safe?' (comments/1nz8cqb, 2025) is a 2025 trip-planning anchor. The 2025 scams: (a) 'Special Taxi' / Coopataxi kiosks inside REC arrivals quote R$ 100–R$ 200 to Boa Viagem (real Uber R$ 30–R$ 60); (b) sign-holders posing as 'pousada transfer' agents intercepting tourists; (c) Uber driver cancel-and-recontract scam — same template as Salvador / Rio; (d) 'meter broken' yellow taxi demands at hotel arrival with R$ 150+ flat-rate cash demand; (e) REC-to-Olinda 'connecting transfer R$ 250' sold by touts (real Uber R$ 60–R$ 90 for the 12-km cross-city ride); (f) 'overnight surcharge R$ 50' added unannounced after late-night arrivals (no such legitimate surcharge); (g) hotel-concierge 'recommended driver R$ 200' kickback markup; (h) credit-card cloning at unofficial taxi-cooperative counters via 'manual entry' card-machines. For older travellers: (1) book Uber, 99, or InDriver on airport Wi-Fi AFTER luggage — typical REC to Boa Viagem R$ 30–R$ 60 (15 min); to Recife Antigo (Centro) R$ 40–R$ 70 (20 min); to Olinda R$ 60–R$ 90 (25 min); meet driver at the designated 'Aplicativos' (apps) pickup zone signposted at terminal exit; (2) IGNORE every 'Special Taxi' kiosk inside terminal quoting above R$ 100 to Boa Viagem; (3) the Recife Metro Centro line connects REC to Centro for R$ 4.30 (35 min, runs 5 AM–11 PM) — budget alternative; (4) NEVER hand a credit card to any taxi driver — pay in-app or cash only; (5) for late-night arrivals (post-22:00), Uber Comfort or 99 Top is worth the R$ 10–R$ 20 surcharge; (6) for Olinda, use Uber direct (not REC airport-arranged transfer); (7) save DEATUR Recife +55 81 3322 4830 (English available, Praça do Marco Zero, Recife Antigo); US Consulate Recife +55 81 3416 3050 (covers all of NE Brazil).
scams.avoidance: Book Uber/99/InDriver on airport Wi-Fi: REC-Boa Viagem R$ 30–R$ 60 Olinda via Uber R$ 60–R$ 90 (NOT REC airport arrangement) OR Recife Metro Centro line R$ 4.30 (35 min, 5 AM–11 PM) NEVER hand credit card to any taxi driver DEATUR Recife +55 81 3322 4830; US Consulate Recife +55 81 3416 3050
scams.location: Recife Guararapes International Airport (REC) arrivals halls, 'Special Taxi' / Coopataxi kiosks, Boa Viagem / Recife Antigo / Olinda drop-offs

scams.name: Boa Viagem Beach Shark-Attack Risk & 'Safe Swimming Zone' Misinformation Scam
scams.description: Praia de Boa Viagem — Recife's main urban beach — sits on one of the world's most documented shark-attack coastlines, and the broader Pernambuco metro region (Boa Viagem, Piedade, Paulista / Olinda) has logged repeated fatal incidents through 2026. This is NOT a financial scam but a critical safety issue tourists are often misinformed about by hotel staff and beach vendors. r/Brazil 'Teen Dies in Shark Attack After Predator Ate Almost His' (comments/1qru2oj, 2026) is the CANONICAL 2026 named anchor — 13-year-old Deivson Rocha Dantas was killed at Praia Del Chifre (Olinda / Paulista side, ~20 km north of Boa Viagem) on 29 Jan 2026. r/Brazil 'Recife is it that dangerous?' (comments/1kkcjvf, 2025) is a 2025 community anchor. r/Brazil 'Beaches in Recife' (comments/1eymgf5, 2024) and 'Nice beaches near Recife where you can swim and not' (comments/1ezb4cl, 2024) document the swim-safety landscape. r/Brazil 'First visit to Brazil and considering Recife' (comments/1qmghss, 2026) is a 2026 first-person community anchor. The 2025–2026 reality: (a) Boa Viagem has recorded 60+ documented shark attacks since 1992 with 25+ fatalities — one of the world's highest attack rates per beach, per CEMIT (Comitê Estadual de Monitoramento de Incidentes com Tubarões) data published by the Pernambuco state government; (b) the cause is a combination of environmental factors (Suape Port construction in the 1990s disrupted bull-shark migratory routes along the reef channel) and an active bull-shark / tiger-shark population in the offshore reef system; (c) the 2026 Praia Del Chifre fatality shows that the RISK ZONE extends north of Boa Viagem into Olinda and Paulista — not just the urban-Recife strip; (d) red-and-yellow warning signs are POSTED at all Boa Viagem beach access points (in Portuguese AND English) — they are not decoration, they identify the actual danger zone past the reef line; (e) some hotel concierges and beach kiosk vendors DOWNPLAY the risk to retain tourists ('the signs are old', 'attacks haven't happened recently') — this is misinformation; (f) 'safe swimming zones' marked on Boa Viagem are the natural tide pools INSIDE the reef line at low tide ONLY — NOT past the reef; (g) 'beach lifeguard says it's safe today' is unreliable — risk varies by time of day, tide, and water conditions, and lifeguards may not have current shark-spotting data. For older travellers — and any traveller considering swimming in metropolitan Recife: (1) DO NOT swim at Boa Viagem past the reef line (0–50m from shore is the natural tide-pool zone; past the reef is shark territory); (2) for actual ocean swimming, travel south to PRAIA DE PIEDADE (immediately south of Boa Viagem — still within the CEMIT risk zone, swim only 0–50m from shore with lifeguards present), PRAIA DO PAIVA (30 min south, gated-community beach, outside the shark-attack hot-zone per 2025 CEMIT data), or best of all PORTO DE GALINHAS (1-hour bus / Uber south, natural reef tide pools, zero shark attacks on record — Brazil's gold-standard safe beach); (3) AVOID Paulista / Praia Del Chifre / Olinda-side beaches for swimming after the Jan 2026 Del Chifre fatality — sightseeing only; (4) ALWAYS swim between the red-and-yellow lifeguard flags; NEVER outside them regardless of what a vendor or concierge tells you; (5) lifeguard hours on Boa Viagem are 8 AM–5 PM — Corpo de Bombeiros 193 for any emergency; (6) DISREGARD 'the signs are old' or 'no attacks since…' statements from hotel staff, kiosk vendors, or tour operators — the 2026 Del Chifre fatality (comments/1qru2oj, 2026) documents the risk is ACTIVE; (7) for older travellers, the best day-trip is Porto de Galinhas — book an Uber round-trip (R$ 360–R$ 450) or public Ônibus R$ 22 from TIP terminal; reputable beach operators: Jangada Tours Porto de Galinhas, Maragogi Tours; (8) if you DO swim at Boa Viagem, go ONLY between 10 AM–4 PM when lifeguards are fully staffed and the tide pools are most visible; (9) DEATUR Recife +55 81 3184 3450; SAMU 192; Polícia Militar 190.
scams.avoidance: DO NOT swim at Boa Viagem past the reef line (60+ attacks, 25+ fatalities since 1992 per CEMIT data) Boa Viagem safe for sunbathing, walking, low-tide natural-pool wading inside the reef ONLY For real swimming: Uber / Ônibus to Porto de Galinhas (1h south, zero shark history, natural reef pools) Red-and-yellow lifeguard flag = swim zone; RED FLAG = NO ENTRY; flags current-day and authoritative Emergency: Corpo de Bombeiros 193; SAMU 192; DEATUR Recife +55 81 3184 3450
scams.location: Praia de Boa Viagem (full 7-km strip, Recife south zone), Praia do Pina, Praia da Piedade, hotel-zone beachfront, beach kiosk (quiosque) zones

scams.name: Recife Antigo / Marco Zero Pickpocket & Phone-Snatch Ring
scams.description: Recife's Centro Histórico (Recife Antigo + Marco Zero + Casa da Cultura) hosts the city's highest-density tourist-pickpocket activity. r/Brazil 'planning solo trip to Recife, Natal & Salvador. Is it safe?' (comments/1nz8cqb, 2025) is the canonical 2025 community anchor. r/Brazil 'First visit to Brazil and considering Recife' (comments/1qmghss, 2026) is a 2026 first-person anchor. r/Brazil 'Recife is it that dangerous?' (comments/1kkcjvf, 2025) and 'About to go to brazil for 5 months' (comments/1mn8zdq, 2025) cover the broader 2025 safety landscape. r/Brazil 'Tips/advice for recife' (comments/27xhat, 2014) provides community baseline; r/Brazil 'Cultural itinerary in Northeast Brazil (Pernambuco &' (comments/1qgohq9, 2026) is a 2026 community itinerary anchor. The 2025 scams: (a) Marco Zero plaza organised pickpocket teams targeting visitors photographing the iconic compass mosaic + Kahal Zur Israel synagogue (oldest in Americas) — distraction-theft templates similar to São Paulo 'clowns'; (b) Casa da Cultura (former 19th-century prison turned artisan market) interior — distraction-team brushing past in narrow stall aisles; (c) Cais do Sertão museum approach — phone-snatch from outdoor café tables; (d) Rua do Bom Jesus narrow cobblestone funnel — pickpocket-team setups at Sunday-market crowds; (e) 'helpful local' offering directions while watching your bag; (f) variant: 'your shoelace is untied' distraction at Marco Zero crowds; (g) variant: 'dropped wallet' team where one 'finds' a wallet, asks tourist 'is it yours?' as cover for pocket-pick by partner; (h) night-time Recife Antigo is significantly less safe — most documented theft happens post-19:00 in the colonial-zone narrow streets. For older travellers: (1) Recife Antigo / Marco Zero is WORTH visiting for the colonial architecture (Marco Zero compass mosaic, Kahal Zur Israel synagogue, Cais do Sertão museum, Casa da Cultura, Paço Alfândega shopping centre) — but go ONLY DURING DAYTIME (9 AM–5 PM) on weekdays; weekends are louder + more pickpocket cover; (2) bring NOTHING you can't afford to lose — leave passport, jewellery, valuable watch in hotel safe; (3) wear a money belt OR crossbody bag with zipper; no back-pocket wallets; (4) keep phone in zipped front pocket between uses; NEVER on outdoor café table; (5) for photographs at Marco Zero / Kahal Zur Israel, use phone-timer or ask SECURITY GUARDS / hotel staff; (6) take Uber/99 BETWEEN sights and your hotel — do NOT walk to / from Recife Antigo at night; (7) AVOID Recife Antigo after dark (post-19:00) unless going directly to a specific reserved-table restaurant via Uber drop-off; (8) for Sunday markets at Marco Zero (10 AM–5 PM), go in the morning when crowds are sparser; (9) DEATUR Recife +55 81 3322 4830 (Praça do Marco Zero, in Recife Antigo); file Boletim de Ocorrência (BO) within 24 hours for insurance + chargebacks.
scams.avoidance: Recife Antigo daytime only (9 AM–5 PM weekdays preferred) Leave valuables in hotel safe; money belt + crossbody bag with zipper Phone in zipped front pocket; never on outdoor café table Uber/99 BETWEEN sights and hotel; avoid post-19:00 walking Sunday market: go 10–12 AM when crowds sparser; DEATUR +55 81 3322 4830
scams.location: Recife Antigo (old town colonial centre), Marco Zero plaza, Rua do Bom Jesus (synagogue street), Cais do Sertão / Paço Alfândega, Bairro do Recife waterfront, Casa da Cultura Centro

scams.name: Olinda Day-Trip Tour Commission & 'Mandatory Guide' Pelourinho Scam
scams.description: Olinda — UNESCO-listed colonial old town on a hill 6 km north of Recife — is Recife's flagship day-trip and hosts a 2025 'mandatory local guide' commission scam plus tour-operator commission stops. r/Brazil 'Tips for living in Recife/Olinda' (comments/1f7gmx, 2014) is the community baseline. r/Brazil 'Cultural itinerary in Northeast Brazil (Pernambuco &' (comments/1qgohq9, 2026) is a 2026 itinerary anchor. r/Brazil 'First visit to Brazil and considering Recife' (comments/1qmghss, 2026) is a 2026 first-person anchor. r/Brazil 'Onde ir em Pernambuco?' (comments/1dichpv, 2025) and 'Hello /r/Brazil. I am a Canadian traveling to Recife for 3' (comments/231vi7, 2014) cover the regional landscape. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Alto da Sé (Olinda's iconic hilltop viewpoint with 360° Recife panorama) — 'mandatory local guide R$ 100' demanded by self-appointed Pelourinho-style touts at the viewpoint plaza; no guide is required — Olinda is a free public UNESCO town walkable in 2–3 hours; (b) hotel-concierge 'Olinda + Recife Antigo combined day-trip R$ 350 per person' kickback markup (real DIY: R$ 60–R$ 90 Uber round-trip + free walking = R$ 100 per couple); (c) 'private heritage tour with English-speaking guide R$ 250 per person' (Free Walker Tour Olinda offers donation-based tours at R$ 30–R$ 50 voluntary per person); (d) commission-restaurant lunch stops at Recife-side tour-operator routes — 'Mariscada Pernambucana lunch R$ 200 per person' at commission-kickback restaurants vs R$ 80–R$ 130 at authentic Olinda spots; (e) 'commission-shop atelier visit R$ 100 mandatory' at Olinda artisan workshops on tour routes; (f) 'photo with frevo dancer R$ 80' at Alto da Sé (legitimate frevo street performances are tip-based at R$ 5–R$ 20 voluntary); (g) Olinda Carnaval (one of Brazil's most authentic) attracts fake-ticket resellers per r/Brazil 'For those who have experienced Carnaval in more than 1' (comments/1i0vflc, 2025) — there are NO tickets for Olinda street Carnaval; it's free public access to all blocos. For older travellers: (1) Olinda is best done DIY — take Uber from Recife to Praça do Carmo / Alto da Sé R$ 30–R$ 50 (15 min); (2) Olinda is a small UNESCO old town walkable in 2–3 hours — main sights: Alto da Sé viewpoint, Mosteiro de São Bento (gilded interior, free entry), Igreja da Sé (Cathedral), Casa do Carnaval, Largo do Boa Hora; (3) NO mandatory guide is required anywhere in Olinda; if you want a guide, book FREE Walker Tour Olinda (donation-based R$ 30–R$ 50 voluntary at end) or licensed PE Tourism Office guides at the Praça do Carmo information centre R$ 80–R$ 150 PER GROUP (4–8 people); (4) REFUSE every 'mandatory local guide R$ 100' Alto da Sé tout — they have no authority; (5) eat at AUTHENTIC Olinda spots: Restaurante Oficina do Sabor (Rua do Amparo, Pernambuco classic, Google 4.5+, R$ 70–R$ 150 per meal), Restaurante Goya (Largo da Misericórdia, Pernambuco regional, R$ 60–R$ 120), Don Francisco Bistrô (Rua do Amparo, contemporary, R$ 80–R$ 180); (6) for the iconic Olinda photo (Alto da Sé sunset over Recife skyline), arrive 5 PM weekday for the best views with sparser crowds; (7) Olinda Carnaval (Feb–Mar) is FREE public access — refuse every 'Olinda Carnaval VIP ticket R$ 500+' offer; book Recife/Olinda accommodation 6+ months ahead for Carnaval dates; (8) DEATUR Olinda +55 81 3429 0008 (Praça do Carmo); the town is generally safe daytime but avoid late-night walking in narrow lanes.
scams.avoidance: DIY: Uber Recife-Olinda R$ 30–R$ 50 (15 min); walkable 2–3 hours NO mandatory guide; Free Walker Tour Olinda R$ 30–R$ 50 voluntary OR PE Tourism R$ 80–R$ 150/GROUP Eat: Oficina do Sabor, Restaurante Goya, Don Francisco Bistrô R$ 60–R$ 180 Frevo street performance: tip R$ 5–R$ 20 voluntary, refuse R$ 80 demands Olinda Carnaval is FREE; refuse 'VIP ticket' offers
scams.location: Olinda Centro Histórico (UNESCO colonial old town, 6 km north of Recife), Alto da Sé viewpoint, Mosteiro de São Bento, Boa Viagem hotel-concierge tour desks, Recife-side day-trip operators

scams.name: Recife Boa Viagem Restaurant Couvert + Serviço Padding & 'Frutos do Mar Market Price' Trap
scams.description: Recife's Boa Viagem beachfront and Recife Antigo dining hubs host a 2025 couvert artístico + serviço padding ecosystem common to Brazilian coastal cities, plus a specific 'frutos do mar peso variável' (variable-weight seafood platter) overcharge pattern. r/Brazil 'Travelling to Recife for 2 weeks. What are the must see and' (comments/1s447c, 2024) and 'Tips/advice for recife' (comments/27xhat, 2014) are community baselines. r/Brazil 'Cultural itinerary in Northeast Brazil (Pernambuco &' (comments/1qgohq9, 2026) is a 2026 itinerary anchor. r/Brazil 'First visit to Brazil and considering Recife' (comments/1qmghss, 2026) is a 2026 first-person anchor. r/saopaulo 'Abusive practices of restaurants and bars' (comments/1ly0v14, 2025) is the cross-region anchor for Brazilian couvert / serviço abuse patterns. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Boa Viagem beachfront restaurants with 'couvert artístico R$ 25–R$ 60 per person' for live music that's a single guitarist for 30 min — legitimate is R$ 10–R$ 25 disclosed BEFORE seating; (b) 'serviço 13–15%' instead of standard 10% (Brazilian Lei 13.419/2017 makes serviço OPTIONAL — you can refuse); (c) 'taxa de couvert + serviço' double-charging (illegal per PROCON PE); (d) 'frutos do mar para 2' (seafood platter for 2) market-price quoted at R$ 350–R$ 600 without weight or species disclosed (real R$ 150–R$ 280 at authentic spots with same items); (e) 'lagosta peso variável' market-price lobster at R$ 800–R$ 1,400 per kg without weight disclosed; (f) 'agua mineral R$ 18' (real R$ 5–R$ 10); (g) 'caipirinha de cachaça artesanal R$ 45' from house cachaça (real R$ 18–R$ 30); (h) Recife Antigo USD-only menus at 2–3× local prices for Pernambucano dishes; (i) bill-switcheroo where R$ amount on receipt differs from card by R$ 50–R$ 200; (j) Marco Zero Sunday-market food stalls overcharging tourists 1.5–2× weekday rates. For older travellers: (1) eat at AUTHENTIC Pernambucano spots: Restaurante Oficina do Sabor (Olinda, Pernambuco classic, Google 4.5+, R$ 70–R$ 150 per meal), Beijupirá (Boa Viagem, contemporary Northeast cuisine, R$ 100–R$ 250), Veggie Lab (Boa Viagem, vegetarian-friendly Pernambucano, R$ 60–R$ 130), Restaurante Leite (Recife Antigo, traditional Brazilian since 1882, R$ 80–R$ 180), Pernambucanas Casa da Tia Anastácia (Boa Viagem, working-class authentic, R$ 50–R$ 100); (2) BEFORE sitting, ASK for menu and CONFIRM (a) couvert artístico R$ amount per person (legitimate R$ 10–R$ 25), (b) serviço % policy (10% standard, OPTIONAL by Brazilian law), (c) credit-card surcharge — photograph the menu; (3) for FRUTOS DO MAR PARA 2 (seafood platter for 2 — Pernambuco's signature dish), agree the EXACT items + weight + price IN WRITING BEFORE cooking — fair platter R$ 150–R$ 280 with shrimp + mussels + clams + fish; refuse 'market price R$ 350–R$ 600' without itemisation; (4) for lobster, agree weight × R$ 400–R$ 700 per kg in writing; (5) 'serviço' is OPTIONAL by Brazilian Lei 13.419/2017 — tip 10% if happy, refuse if poor service or padded; (6) for water, order 'água sem gás copo' (free tap water) at most spots; (7) for caipirinha, expect R$ 18–R$ 30 at reputable spots — anything above R$ 50 is tourist-trap; (8) PROCON PE can be contacted via 151 or procon.pe.gov.br for any abusive bill.
scams.avoidance: Eat: Oficina do Sabor (Olinda), Beijupirá, Veggie Lab, Restaurante Leite, Tia Anastácia BEFORE sitting confirm couvert + serviço + card surcharge in writing Frutos do Mar para 2: agree items + weight + price IN WRITING (R$ 150–R$ 280 fair) Lobster: agree weight × R$ 400–R$ 700/kg in writing PROCON PE: 151 or procon.pe.gov.br for abusive bills
scams.location: Boa Viagem beachfront restaurants (Avenida Boa Viagem, Avenida Conselheiro Aguiar), Recife Antigo Marco Zero restaurants, Casa da Cultura Centro tourist-menu spots, Pina waterfront dining strip

scams.name: Recife Carnaval Frevo Booking Fraud & Galo da Madrugada Counterfeit-Ticket Scam
scams.description: Recife / Olinda Carnaval (4–7 day event in Feb, Brazil's most authentic frevo + maracatu street Carnaval — the Galo da Madrugada bloco is Guinness-recorded as the world's largest Carnaval bloco with 2.5+ million participants) drives accommodation prices 5–10× normal — and a 2025 cancel-and-relist + counterfeit-Camarote-ticket fraud ecosystem mirrors the Salvador / Rio pattern. r/Brazil 'For those who have experienced Carnaval in more than 1' (comments/1i0vflc, 2025) and 'Where is the best Carnaval in Brazil?' (comments/1nbxlbf, 2025) are 2025 community anchors comparing Brazilian Carnaval cities. r/Brazil 'Carnaval Planer 2026' (comments/1otaioq, 2026) is a 2026 first-person planning anchor. r/Brazil "Is Carnaval 'worth it' if you don't drink?" (comments/1irluug, 2025) provides 2025 community perspective. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Booking.com / Airbnb 'phantom listings' for Recife / Olinda Carnaval — high-quality photos of properties that don't exist or are already booked; tourist pays in advance, arrives, finds no property; (b) confirmed-booking cancellation 30–60 days before Carnaval with re-listing at 5–10× original price; (c) WhatsApp 'private Olinda Centro apartment for Carnaval R$ 5,000/night' demanding 100% PIX upfront — irreversible Brazilian payment; (d) 'Camarote VIP ticket Galo da Madrugada R$ 2,500' from unauthorised resellers (real Camarote prices R$ 800–R$ 3,000 from official venue websites — Camarote da Praça, Camarote Boa Viagem, Camarote Estrelas); (e) 'Olinda Carnaval VIP entry R$ 800' (Olinda Carnaval is FREE public access — there is NO ticket); (f) 'mandatory Carnaval pousada package R$ 6,000 for 5 nights' that's 5× normal nightly rate; (g) on-arrival bait-and-switch from confirmed Boa Viagem to inferior unit; (h) 'cleaning deposit R$ 600 cash on arrival' that never returns; (i) 'frevo bloco T-shirt R$ 400' counterfeit (real R$ 150–R$ 350 from official bloco websites — Bloco da Madrugada, Bloco do Eu Sozinho, Bloco da Saudade); (j) 'private trio elétrico ride R$ 1,500/person' on Galo da Madrugada (the bloco is FREE participation — ANYONE can walk with it; only Camarote VIP balconies are paid). For older travellers: (1) for Recife / Olinda Carnaval, BOOK 9–12 MONTHS AHEAD via Booking.com or established hotel chains with platform-protected payment; reputable Recife hotels: Atlante Plaza Hotel (Boa Viagem, beachfront), Mar Hotel Conventions, Best Western Premier Maceió (also Pernambuco coast), Sheraton Reserva do Paiva; reputable Olinda pousadas: Pousada do Amparo (Centro Histórico, boutique), Pousada do Bonfim, Hotel 7 Colinas; AVOID Airbnb peak-season (cancel-and-relist documented across Brazil); (2) NEVER PIX-transfer to private 'apartment' or 'villa' WhatsApp sellers — irreversible; only platform-secure payment; (3) Olinda Carnaval is FREE PUBLIC ACCESS — refuse every 'Olinda Carnaval VIP ticket R$ 500+' offer; (4) for Recife Galo da Madrugada Camarote VIP, buy ONLY from the Camarote's OFFICIAL website (galodamadrugada.org.br, camarotedapracarecife.com.br) at R$ 800–R$ 3,000 per night; refuse every 'private reseller R$ 2,500+' offer; (5) for frevo bloco T-shirts, buy ONLY from each bloco's official website at R$ 150–R$ 350; (6) for older travellers, AVOID street Carnaval crowd density (2.5 million Galo da Madrugada participants is intense, pickpocketing risk is high) — pay for a Camarote (elevated VIP balcony with food / drink / restroom / security) for safe Carnaval experience; (7) cross-reference any pousada / Camarote on Google Maps + Tripadvisor BEFORE booking; (8) DEATUR Recife +55 81 3322 4830 for booking-fraud denuncia within 48 hours; (9) for budget Carnaval, base in less-stressed Boa Viagem south end (3 km south of Galo circuit) and Uber into circuits — half the Recife Antigo rate.
scams.avoidance: Book Carnaval 9–12 months ahead via Booking.com / hotel chains Reputable Recife: Atlante Plaza, Mar Hotel, Sheraton Reserva do Paiva Reputable Olinda: Pousada do Amparo, Pousada do Bonfim, Hotel 7 Colinas Camarote ONLY from official: galodamadrugada.org.br, camarotedapracarecife.com.br Older travellers: pay for Camarote (avoid 2.5M-person Galo crowd)
scams.location: Recife Carnaval circuits (Galo da Madrugada Recife Antigo, Olinda streets, Boa Viagem blocos), online ticket resellers, hotel-concierge Carnaval-package bookings, WhatsApp 'private apartment' Carnaval rentals
